== Dialogues ==

Sirran will have various conversations with you island by island. Because Sirran's conversations seem to flow together, I've put them all here, rather than on their individual islands.

However, before going through his non-aggressive text, let's see what Sirran has to say if he's ever irritated into attacking.

''' Any Island, if Sirran decides to attack: '''

: Sirran the Lunatic says 'What?! Now you've done it! The bunnies are angry! ANGRY I TELL YOU!' 

If you ever find Sirran saying these words, pray for mercy...

''' Island 1, after killing [[Thunder Spirit Princess]]: '''

You say, 'Hail, Sirran the Lunatic'
: Sirran the Lunatic says 'Ehem! What? Oh, hello there! Sirran be my name. Yes? So, come to the Plane of Sky, have you? Killed all my fairies! Hah! So! Do you wish to know how to traverse this plane? Or should I just go away? I know much about this plane. You would do well to listen!'
You say, 'I wish to know how to traverse this plane'
: Sirran the Lunatic says 'Ahah! Wise you are and tell you I will. Hrm? Don't have wings, do you? Fairies have swords! Fairies stole my lucky feet! Hand me them, one by one, and be in for a treat! Haha!'
: (A variety of attempts were made to get him to say more, but with no luck) 

''' Island 1, after turning in either of the Key Loots for a Key: '''

: Sirran the Lunatic says 'These are the keys! Use them well! Hold them in your hand and touch them to the runed platforms! Guide you thy will! Hah! The last to go, must tell me so, or be in for a [hassle]! If there's a hassle, I will go!'
: (Absolutely no combination of "hassle" did he respond to!) 

'''Island 2, after killing [[Protector of Sky]]:'''

You say, 'Hail, Sirran the Lunatic'
: Sirran the Lunatic says 'Ah! Come far you have! You are all crazy! I like it! Swords spin no more! Spin, spin. Unlucky they were! I thought them [vain]!'
: (Absolutely no combination of "vain" did he respond to!) 

''' Island 2, after turning in Broken Mirror for Key of Misfortune: '''

: Sirran the Lunatic says 'You move fast, you crazy kids! Keep going! Prod you I will! Stuck here I have been! Oh! Let me know when you are [done] or this will be no fun! Haha!'
: (Absolutely no combination of "done" did he respond to!) 

''' Island 3, after killing [[Gorgalosk]]: '''

You say, 'Hail, Sirran the Lunatic'
: Sirran the Lunatic says 'What! Die already! Come so far. Can't you see I am cold! Give me a cloak or something! Bah! You don't look the type to give anything! Be off with you, then!'
: Sirran the Lunatic says 'Always want something for nothing? Oh yes, you gave me something! Here you go! Take this! Used one you have. [Teleport] away you will! Let me know, or no kill! Haha!'
: (Absolutely no combination of "Teleport" did he respond to! Also note that I did not hand him anything, yet he still gave this 2nd line of text.)
: [Best Guess: He wants me to turn in "Light Woolen Cloak (possibly it is "Fine Wool Cloak" or maybe "Light Woolen Mantle") or "Grey Damask Cloak", both rare drops from Gorgalosk] 

''' Island 3, after turning in Animal Figurine for Key of Beasts: '''

: Sirran the Lunatic says 'Always want something for nothing? Oh yes, you gave me something! Here you go! Take this! Used one you have. [Teleport] away you will! Let me know, or no kill! Haha!'

''' Island 4, after turning in Bird Whistle for Avian Key: '''

: (Absolutely no combination of "Icky Bicky Barket" did he respond to!)

== GM Narris ==

Allegedly, Sirran was a reference to GM Narris who worked at Verant until they were caught RMTing and got fired for it. This caused a mental breakdown and he injured himself by bashing his head against the wall and floor and stabbing himself with his car keys. [https://old.reddit.com/r/AskReddit/comments/1aj5qh/employers_of_reddit_what_are_your_crazy_employee/c8xybco/] This prompted devs to add the [[Key Master]] and Sirran (anagram of Narris) to the game. A phrase in Sirran's final dialogue ("No one cares about Narris.") seems to confirm this.
